requester.chat: Soporte Worker - Actualizacion de tickets de venta

objective: Tickets de venta — cierre de auditoria: esquema completo de Cliente (singular) MPRO y catalogos de descuento separados sin truncamiento; identificar base realmente consultada y claves de unicidad. La evidencia de MPRO procede del contexto POS resuelto (CENTRAL2020); no certificar API local de Ventas del Dia con esta evidencia. Solo lectura.

queries.name: ORIGEN_cliente_completo
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS base_datos,TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,DATA_TYPE,CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH,IS_NULLABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE LOWER(TABLE_NAME)='cliente' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: ORIGEN_tablas_descuento
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS base_datos,TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%descuento%' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME

queries.name: ORIGEN_indices_cliente_comanda
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS base_datos,t.name AS tabla,i.name AS indice,i.is_unique,ic.key_ordinal,c.name AS columna FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE LOWER(t.name) IN ('cliente','comanda','comanda_detalle') AND ic.key_ordinal>0 ORDER BY t.name,i.name,ic.key_ordinal
